integrity.review_record_hash_semantics: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for each evidence record excluding review_record_sha256; this hashes the review receipt, not source HTML/PDF.

limitations: Primary pages were accessed during the 2026 review, not collected contemporaneously; their historical datelines are evidence about the event, not proof of immutable historical availability.
Date-only rows have no invented timestamp. Exact rows retain a printed timezone-backed release time; earliest dissemination still needs independent audit.
All transaction statuses describe the proposed deal at announcement, not current completion or termination outcomes.
100 percent means intended post-transaction whole-company ownership, not minimum tender conditions, acceptance rate or incremental shares purchased.
CIK lineage comes from the existing SEC candidate ledger and name match; primary announcements establish issuer identity/listing and control terms.
This is an agent-produced review seed. Independent label audit, complete event ascertainment, delisted-inclusive risk sets and historical point-in-time feature data remain necessary before training.

listing_evidence.scope: Issuer/acquirer statement of contemporaneous target listing; not a reconstructed exchange membership history.

records.primary_evidence_paraphrase: Sun Pharma and Nasdaq-listed Concert announce a definitive tender offer for all Concert common shares, followed by a second-step merger. The consideration is USD8 cash plus a nontradeable contingent right for up to USD3.50, conditional on later sales milestones. The proposed ownership is the whole company; no contingent payout or closing is asserted.

records.primary_evidence_paraphrase: Nasdaq-listed Fusion announces its definitive acquisition by AstraZeneca. The statutory plan of arrangement covers all outstanding shares for USD21 cash plus a USD3 contingent cash right tied to a regulatory milestone. The announcement remains distinct from later shareholder approval, regulatory clearance and completion.
